text:
incident-bot: PAGER: elevated 502/5xx from /api/v1/chat for canary-nodes in prod-east. error-rate 18% over 3m. tagging #oncall and #eng-release.

rachel: oncall here, seeing alerts. which release?

sam: release id release-2026-03-15-18:20 promoted to canary 10 minutes ago. I just merged a secrets sync change to switch default secret path to /prod/models/latest.

priya: got it, looking at Vault. logs from sidecar show: 
```
2026-03-15T18:27:03Z ERROR fetch secret failed: Path not found: secret/data/prod/models/latest
2026-03-15T18:27:03Z WARN fallback to env var INFERENCE_KEY empty
2026-03-15T18:27:03Z ERROR model init failed: missing decryption key
```

rachel: so the new secret path doesn't exist in Vault, instances can't fetch model decryption keys -> 502s. Did the sync job populate vault before deploy?

sam: we had a sync job but it was queued behind rotation. I thought rotation would write to both /prod/models/latest and /prod/models/old. apparently only old got populated.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic still 10%. Do you want to reduce traffic or rollback?

rachel: flip canary off and route 100% to stable. Sam, toggle kill-switch.

sam: toggled canary flag to OFF via feature-flag service. Confirmed: canary group removed from LB.

incident-bot: NOTE: canary traffic reduced to 0% in 45s. 502 rate decreasing.

priya: quick mitigation options: 1) create missing path in Vault with the correct secret (fast) 2) rollback release (safe) 3) patch sidecar to fallback to previous path. Creating secret is fastest but needs validation.

rachel: what's the blast radius? how many customers impacted?

monitoring-bot: Query by error tag shows ~9 tenant IDs with failed requests between 18:26-18:30; total ~320 failed requests. Error duration ~6m.

cs: we'll need to notify those tenants. Please draft brief.

sam: I'll repro locally, but for prod we can write the missing secret entry to Vault with same payload as /prod/models/old and hit the sidecar health endpoint to confirm.

devops: hold — we need ACL checks. Vault policy for automation role does not allow writing to /prod/models/latest, only to /prod/models/old per last rotation. Attempting to write will fail with permission denied.

priya: that's consistent with rotation policy change from last night: automation role got write to old only. Ops ticket ROT-912 changed permissions. Looks like an oversight.

rachel: decision: do not attempt manual write; rollback is faster and avoids touching keypaths. Initiate rollback to stable.

deploy-bot: rollback queued. ETA ~3m.

sam: initiating customer-facing note: "We briefly served errors for some requests during a canary deploy. Root cause appears to be a secret path change during the release which meant canary instances couldn't retrieve model keys. We rolled back the canary and restored service. Investigating fixes and will follow up with full postmortem." Comments?

cs: include that no model data was leaked and no data loss. Ask customers to share request IDs if they still see issues.

deploy-bot: rollback complete. Traffic back to stable. Error rates back to baseline.

monitoring-bot: baseline restored at 18:34. No new elevated 5xx.

priya: root cause preliminary: release changed secret path to new alias but Vault ACLs weren't updated to allow automation role to write/read that path. Canary instances attempted fetch, failed, and returned 502.

rachel: oncall handoff note: incident resolved, rollback performed, brief customer notifications sent by @cs, root cause preliminary is vault ACL mismatch during secret path switch. Next oncall please monitor Vault AccessDenied spikes and 5xx on /api/v1/chat.

sam: action items: - OPS-431: update rotation script to synchronously write both paths before switching alias, and ensure policy grants to automation role. - ENG-782: add preflight CI check that validates secret path exists and is readable by service role for any deploy that references a secret path env var. - MON-223: add alert for Vault Path Not Found or Vault ACL denies in sidecar logs.

priya: also propose gating secret-path changes behind manual approval in release pipeline if path is prod.

devops: acknowledged, will update ACLs and rotation runbook.

cs: sending customer notices now. Slack stub: "Service briefly impacted for some requests during a canary deploy due to a secret path update. Rollback completed and service restored. We are investigating and will follow up with timeline and mitigations."

rachel: thanks everyone. Leaving as resolved. Follow-up postmortem requested and assign to @sam and @priya.

sam: will write RCA and link OPS-431 and ENG-782.

monitoring-bot: closing incident thread at 18:40.
